message.content:
**UNO – Game Rules Overview** | Section | Details | |---------|--------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score at least 500 points across multiple rounds. Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when you finish a round. | | **Deck** | Standard UNO set has 108 cards:
• Four colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 each
• Each color includes one “0” and two copies of numbers 1‑9.
• Eight action cards per color:
  - *Skip* (2×)
  - *Reverse* (2×)
  - +2 Draw Two (2×)
• Wild cards: four *Wild*, four *Wild+4*. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle all cards.
• Deal seven cards face‑up to each player.
• Place the rest as a draw pile facedown.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile to start the play area. If it’s a wild or action card, treat its effect immediately on the next player. | --- ### Turn Actions On your turn you may do **one** of the following: | Action | How It Works | |-------|--------------| | **Play a matching card** | A card matches either the current color OR the current value/face of the top discard. For example, if the top card is Red 7, you could play any red card or any 7 regardless of color. | | **Draw a card** | Take the top card from the draw pile. You cannot end your turn with this drawn card unless it legally matches the top discard. If it does match, you may play it immediately during the same turn. | | **Use a Wild** | Play a *Wild* or *Wild+4*: declare the new active color before placing the card. This overrides the previous color. | #### Special Cards & Their Effects | Card | Effect When Played | |------|--------------------| | **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. | | **Reverse** | Reverses direction of play (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise). In a 2‑player game, Reverse acts like Skip. | | **+2 Draw Two** | Next player draws two cards AND misses their turn. | | **Wild** | Player declares the next color. | | **Wild+4** | Same as Wild plus the next player draws four cards and skips their turn. *(Can only be played if the player has no legal colored card.)* | > ⚠️ *Rule Variations:* Some house rules allow playing a Wild+4 even if you have a playable color card—this is not official but common in casual games.* --- ### Winning a Round When a player discards their last card they shout "**UNO!**" (or "I’m out") and win the round. Scoring occurs after everyone else finishes drawing until the board clears. #### Point Calculation Points awarded to the winner equal the sum of the values of all opponent cards still held: | Card Type | Value | |-----------|-------| | Numbered cards (0–9) | Face value | | Skip / Reverse / +2 | 20 pts | | Wild / Wild+4 | 50 pts | If the winner had exactly zero cards left (i.e., finished without needing to draw), they receive a bonus of 100 extra points. --- ### Ending the Game First player to reach **≥ 500 total points** wins overall. Many groups prefer shorter thresholds such as 200 or 300 for quicker sessions. --- ### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet ``` Start → Discard Top → Players take turns clockwise: - Match color/value → play - Else -> draw Specials: SKIP → skip next REVERSE → change order +2 → next draws 2 & skips WILD → choose color WILDFOUR → choose color + next draws 4 & skips End round → Score based on leftover cards Repeat until someone ≥ 500 pts ``` Feel free to tweak scoring or add custom cards for variety—but keep the core mechanics intact for classic UNO fun! ---
